verdict.rationale: Close ships an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar tools reach Close data with no code. Its scoped read, write and destructive permissions mean users can operate the CRM through natural-language prompts in those AI clients. However, the evidence shows no built-in natural-language command interface inside Close itself. Chloe is described as a sales agent that calls and qualifies leads, not a command layer for users. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations MCP exposes to natural-language control, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
mcp.write_safe — can read and write data; mcp.write_destructive — can read, write, and delete data
Close's MCP server is officially supported across the Claude ecosystem.
